description: Ask the other person in the current 1:1 chat to share one or more sections of THEIR OWN identity card with you. Only works in a 1:1 -- there is no group equivalent yet. They may share what you asked for, share something else, decline, or ignore it; their answer arrives as its own event, not as a result of this call.

keys.description: Section keys you are asking for, e.g. ["legal_name"].

text.description: Optional one-line reason, shown alongside the ask.

name: identity_ask
